title: 2022 U.S. Senate elections: Will a Democrat or Republican win this state?
description: This is a group market on which parties will win different states in the 2022 U.S. Senate elections, scheduled for November 8 2022.

markets.question: Senate: Will a Democrat (Hassan) or Republican (Bolduc) win in New Hampshire?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to “Democrat” if the candidate who wins the 2022 New Hampshire U.S. Senate election is representing the Democratic Party, or to “Republican” if the candidate who wins the 2022 New Hampshire U.S. Senate election is representing the Republican Party. 

A candidate shall be considered to represent a party in the event that he or she is the nominee, or has a ballot-listed or otherwise identifiable party preference, of the party in question.

If the winning candidate is from a party other than the Democratic or the Republican party, the market will resolve to 50/50.

Determination of the winner of the Senate election will be based on a consensus of credible reporting, or if there is ambiguity, final state election authority certification or other final official determination of the 2022 election results.
markets.groupItemTitle: New Hampshire - Maggie Hassan vs. Don Bolduc
